title: ioBroker State Change Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Home Assistant state/logbook events (`homeassistant:event`), Homey flow/insights (`homey:flow`), SmartThings events (`smartthings:event`), Hubitat/openHAB logs, Node-RED flow events (`nodered:event`).
app: Home Assistant / Homey / SmartThings / Hubitat / openHAB event streams via MQTT, webhooks, and REST — forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=iobroker:state
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(object_id) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many ioBroker state change events land each day and how many distinct object values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest ioBroker state change records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct object values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It compares your how much ioBroker state change activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
